test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A train that is 220 m long overtakes a man moving at a speed of 10 km/hr (in same direction) in 44 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take this train to completely cross another train of a length of 315 m, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 79 km/hr?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed of Train 1 and man = 220 ÷ 44 = 5 m/s = 18 km/hr.

Since they move in the same direction, Train 1 speed = 18 + 10 = 28 km/hr.

For crossing Train 2 in opposite direction, Relative Speed = 28 + 79 = 107 km/hr = 107 × (5 / 18) m/s.

Time to cross = Total Length ÷ Relative Speed = (220 + 315) ÷ [107 × (5 / 18)].

Time = 535 × 18 ÷ 535 = 18 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 220 m
 Speed: 28 km/hr →
 
 
 315 m
 ← Speed: 79 km/hr

 
• 
 
 Opposite Direction: Relative Speeds Add Up
 Total Distance = 220 + 315 = 535 m

**Given:**

Length of Train 1 (L₁) = 220 m

Speed of man = 10 km/hr

Time taken to cross man = 44 seconds

Length of Train 2 (L₂) = 315 m

Speed of Train 2 (V₂) = 79 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

km/hr to m/s conversion: multiply by 5/18

Relative speed (opposite direction) = V₁ + V₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative speed of Train 1 and man = L₁ ÷ Time

⇒ Relative speed = 220 ÷ 44 = 5 m/s

⇒ Converting to km/hr = 5 × (18 ÷ 5) = 18 km/hr

⇒ Since both are moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = V₁ − Speed of man

⇒ V₁ − 10 = 18

⇒ V₁ = 28 km/hr

⇒ For crossing Train 2, Relative speed (opposite direction) = 28 + 79 = 107 km/hr

⇒ Relative speed in m/s = 107 × (5 ÷ 18) = 535 / 18 m/s

⇒ Total distance to be covered = L₁ + L₂ = 220 + 315 = 535 m

⇒ Time required = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 535 ÷ (535 ÷ 18)

⇒ Time = (535 × 18) ÷ 535 = 18 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 18 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed = V₁ − V₂. In opposite directions, it is V₁ + V₂.

Crossing Objects

When a train crosses a stationary pole or moving man, the distance covered is just the length of the train. When crossing a platform or another train, the total distance is the sum of both lengths.

Speed Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.
